hostStep1: Make sure the Linux/VPS/colo host is one you control, with outbound HTTPS to the app API origin (not the Manager password).
hostStep2: Store the enroll token in the host vault (env/file mode 600). Never commit it to git or paste it into a public chat.
hostStep3: From the host, POST {{enrollPath}} with JSON { token, agent_name } — agent_name is unique per machine (1–63 characters).
hostStep4: The response contains agent_id, agent_key, manager_host, install_hint. Keep agent_key on the host only.
hostStep5: Continue with the agent install block below (per distro, using manager_host from the response). Do not guess the Manager IP.
hostStep6: Start the agent, then click Sync in the Guard dashboard. Check the Agents table (active/pending/disconnected) and critical alerts.
installStep1: Prerequisites: a 64-bit Linux host you control; root/sudo; outbound access to manager_host (the agent ↔ Manager port — follow the ops runbook if non-default). Never expose the Manager password on the host.
installStep2: Read the fields from the enroll response: agent_id, agent_key, manager_host, and install_hint (if present, prefer the commands there).
installStep3: Pick the distro command block below (Debian/Ubuntu vs RHEL-family vs SUSE). The package version must match the lab/prod Manager — ask ops if unsure. Do not hardcode lab URLs in a public ticket.
installStep4: After the package is installed: set the Manager address to manager_host from the response (do not guess). Usual path: {{ossecConfPath}} — the <address> element in the client block.
installStep5: Import the agent key: use agent_key (and agent_id when the tool asks) through the official utility (often: {{manageAgentsPath}} or import key), or follow install_hint. Key file mode 600; never log it to CI.
installStep6: Enable the service: sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now wazuh-agent (the unit name may differ). Check: systemctl status wazuh-agent.
installStep7: Verify on the host: the agent is running and local logs show no repeated auth errors. In the app: Guard → Sync → the agent shows active (not stuck pending). Critical alerts appear once the rule level meets the threshold (default ≥ 12).
installStep8: Forbidden: the Wazuh Manager password/user, the global app API key, or internal lab addresses in git/public chat/screenshots. Enrollment always goes through the SaaS token + HTTPS to the app origin.
installIntro: Agent runtime install on the target host — per-distro Linux commands (placeholders only). Prefer install_hint + manager_host from POST {{enrollPath}}. Not a full SIEM tutorial; no lab secrets.
distroDebianBlurb: apt/dpkg family. Replace <WAZUH_VERSION> to match the Manager; prefer install_hint when present.
distroRhelBlurb: rpm/dnf family (yum on older releases). The unit name stays wazuh-agent on official packages.
distroSuseBlurb: zypper. Packages often come from an ops mirror or an equivalent RPM; match the channel to the Manager.
distroFooter: Replace <MANAGER_HOST> with the value from the enroll response. Import agent_key via manage_agents (or install_hint). Local .deb/.rpm option: dpkg -i / rpm -ivh from an ops mirror. Never paste the Manager password or a lab IP into public chat/repo.
